authority: Explicit user decision and seeded-profile instruction in the implementation session
scope: model_autogluon_core_features challenger: restricted AutoGluon 1.4.0 XT profile, not default AutoML or standalone ExtraTrees equivalence
reduced_forest_policy: Reject the experiment if final actual forest contains fewer than or other than 64 trees; no silent profile changes
threading_note: n_jobs=-1 tree threading is permitted. num_cpus=1 remains a backend resource hint, not a campaign CPU cap or proof of one thread. One model fit is distinct from tree/thread count.
holdout_policy: AutoGluon internal holdout may use only the isolated admitted outer-training table; never outer validation, vault or competition-test labels
audit_policy: Exactly one XT model attempt/object with no overlap, including failed or nonsurviving models; the same forest may grow via [64] or warm-start [4,64]. Verify final len(estimators_)=64 and both seeds=42.
promotion_status: Requires parent-owned sequential real tiny-fit proof and final integration validation
